title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts — Credits of an Unfinalized Batch Held Back at Closing
content:
## Desk guidance note — Cartwise Shopper Payouts closing

When a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account is closed, the final disbursement holds back an amount for the shopper's batch that is completed but not yet finalized in Cartwise Shopper Batches. The amount held back depends on the shopper's standing:

- a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Platinum level or above with 40 or more batch base-pay entries in the last 3 months holds back only that batch's tips;
- a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Silver or Gold level with 20 or more batch base-pay entries in the last 3 months holds back those tips plus half of the batch's other credits, the sum rounded to the cent;
- any other shopper holds back every credit of that batch.

### Records read

- **Shopper level**: the level on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond, and a level named with "or above" or "or below" is read in that order. "Platinum level or above" therefore means Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Full-Service Shopper Diamond.
- **Batch base-pay entries**: the base-pay entries posted on the shopper's batches in Cartwise Shopper Batches. "The last 3 months" counts the entries booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the closing.
- **The batch's tips**: the tips posted on the completed, not yet finalized batch in Cartwise Shopper Batches.
- **The batch's credits**: the earnings credits booked to the payout account for that batch; its *other credits* are those credits less the batch's tips.

### Standing table

| Level | Base-pay entries, last 3 months | Held back for the batch |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum or Diamond | 40 or more | The tips only |
| Platinum or Diamond | 39 or fewer | Every credit of the batch |
| Silver or Gold | 20 or more | The tips plus half of the other credits, rounded to the cent |
| Silver or Gold | 19 or fewer | Every credit of the batch |
| Shop-Only Shopper or Full-Service Shopper | any number | Every credit of the batch |

### Hypothetical illustrations

The completed, not yet finalized batch shows credits of 40.00 on the payout account, of which the tips posted on the batch are 11.00; its other credits are 29.00.

- A Full-Service Shopper Diamond with 40 base-pay entries in the last 3 months holds back 11.00.
- A Full-Service Shopper Gold with 20 entries holds back 11.00 plus half of 29.00 (14.50), that is 25.50.
- A Full-Service Shopper Silver with 19 entries holds back every credit: 40.00.
- A Full-Service Shopper Platinum with 39 entries holds back every credit: 40.00.
- A Full-Service Shopper with 60 entries holds back every credit: 40.00.
